Contributing to RdistNN

Source: CONTRIBUTING.md

Read AGENTS.md before editing. The design index routes interface, validation and numerical contracts; the package scope distinguishes supported and experimental workflows. Open an issue before proposing a new estimator or exported-interface change.

Development and production workflow

Work on local development and keep it unpublished until publication is authorized. Branches in a public GitHub repository are public when pushed. For an authorized production update, publish a review branch, open a PR to master, complete review and required checks, then squash-merge. Direct pushes to master require an explicit override. Keep development current with the reviewed production state.

Local setup

Use R 4.1.0 or newer and a C++17 toolchain; OpenMP is optional. From the root:

install.packages(c("devtools", "pkgdown", "rcmdcheck", "yaml"))
devtools::install_deps(dependencies = TRUE)

Use roxygen2 8.0.0, as declared in DESCRIPTION, to avoid generated-file drift. Install the declared version if needed:

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_version("roxygen2", version = "8.0.0", upgrade = "never")

Editing and checking

Changed surface Edit and verify
Function help or exports Edit roxygen in R/; run devtools::document(). Never hand-edit NAMESPACE, man/*.Rd or RcppExports.*.
README Edit README.Rmd; run devtools::build_readme().
Examples or articles Use small seeded examples, guard optional packages, execute changed code and check links/generated output. Refer to the paper for theory.
Behavior or validation Add focused testthat regressions. Select suites using the test map; use the full suite for shared or broad changes.
Release candidate Run the full package/site and cross-platform gates in RELEASING.md.

Preserve public inputs, defaults and result schemas during editorial changes. Identify oracle quantities and distinguish demonstrations from manuscript evidence. Update NEWS.md for user-visible changes.

Run the alignment checks relevant to the changed surface:

Rscript tools/ci/check_tests_declared_deps.R
Rscript tools/ci/check_repository_hygiene.R
Rscript tools/ci/check_pkgdown_reference_coverage.R
Rscript tools/ci/check_generated_file_drift.R
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/ci -v

The generated-file gate regenerates namespace, Rd topics and Rcpp glue in an isolated tree using the declared roxygen2 version. Hygiene checks staged/new candidate files and duplicate top-level R function ownership; local closures may reuse names. Keep check output, archives and private session records under ignored archives/, excluded from source packages. Reuse successful checks while the verified content is unchanged. Reserve build/ for R-generated package metadata, including the vignette index.

R and Stata parity

R is the numerical reference for shared methods. Compare identical inputs, row order, targets, fitted geometry, signals, weight controls and covariance definitions. Require exact discrete decisions and justified numeric tolerances; force and establish each engine, then test automatic fallback separately. Keep independent analytic/deletion references. Do not regenerate golden values merely to make a failure pass. The compiled-code policy owns the arithmetic contract.

The Stata checkout’s tests/R_TEST_CROSSWALK.md maps shared and R-only contracts. Its tools/generate_r_*.R scripts own cross-language fixtures, including reporting and saved-fit references. Run matching Stata regressions after an intentional shared-contract change. PLQR parity concerns supplied-coefficient moments; Stata has no density-backed coefficient inference.

With both checkouts present, verify mirrored native headers from the R root:

python3 ../RdistNN_stata/tools/ci/package_hygiene.py --r-root .

Reporting problems

Open a GitHub issue with a minimal example, expected/actual results and sessionInfo(). For numerical discrepancies, report whether they persist with options(RdistNN.use_compiled = FALSE). This selects R algorithms; source installation still requires compilation.

PRs should describe the final behavior, scope and verification. Maintainer documentation records current contracts and procedures; keep personal paths, session instructions, completed task lists, generated logs and execution receipts in private working records.
